items.title: SD-106 validation: does generic bottleneck variance preservation reach PCA-32 parity at the consumer rung?
items.note: SD-106's pre-set acceptance measurement, per /implement-substrate Step 8. ACCEPTANCE TARGET (set by governance gov-20260911, NOT invented at build time): the observation->z_world latent reaches PCA-32 parity -- >= 0.85 held-out oracle-action agreement at the consumer rung (x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN) on a seed majority. The instrument is IMPORTED FROM V3-EXQ-1010, never re-implemented: capacity ladder, dataset recipe, standardiser, fit protocol, calibration anchor and thresholds all come from x1010/x1008/x1002, and x1010._fit_track_cell performs every cell. The one addition is a fourth track whose encoder trained with the SD-106 objective (preservation_weight=200.0, use_world_encoder_skip=True). 1010 itself is unmodified. | red-team (opus-5; fable requested first, refused by a provider spend limit, re-spawned once on the session model per Step 4.5): CONTESTED -> all 5 findings FIXED, 0 dismissed. F1 the anchor reachability certificate scored best-over-rungs while the gate measured the consumer rung, and the shipped `min` predicate was unmeetable against 1010's own anchor data (0.8578 < 0.85) -> references corrected and the predicate made a seed-majority rule; F2 a None `measured` made p0_readiness_gate raise an UNCAUGHT TypeError on the instrument-failure path, converting the designed substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route into an ERROR with no manifest -> guarded; F3 the C2 non-degeneracy witness (|delta| > 1e-9) could not fail and C1's own non-degeneracy was built on it -> C2 is now the mechanism fact (preservation head ran on every ON cell, no OFF cell); F4 1010's per-arm encoder-health gates were dropped -> encoder-trained and not-collapsed preconditions restored, unused ANCHOR_DEGRADE_TOL removed rather than advertised; F5 three minor (invented reference value, always-null offending_cell, unreachable branch) -> fixed. A sixth defect was found while fixing F4: the restored weight-delta gate read a non-existent key and would have failed forever. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout is oracle-action agreement on an SD-106-ON latent; SD-106 landed 2026-09-11, so no recorded manifest on any substrate_hash can carry it -- not recoverable, run required. | Step 2.5c SCOPED USER EXCEPTION 2026-09-11: three open `corrupting` substrate entries overlap modules any all-ON agent driver exercises -- mode-governance-engagement (ree_core/agent.py, utils/config.py, salience_coordinator.py), contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write) and SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training (e1_deep.py::forward, ::predict_long_horizon). Granted because V3-EXQ-1010, the run governance pre-set as this acceptance measurement, ALREADY EXECUTED under these identical three defects, and this comparison is PAIRED (ON vs OFF vs anchor vs raw, all under the same defects). Recorded so the manifest and any later autopsy see the limitation. | PROMOTES NOTHING on its own; experiment_purpose=diagnostic. A null means the objective at preservation_weight=200.0 does not recover oracle-relevant content on this rung -- NOT that preservation is the wrong lever -> /failure-autopsy, not an automatic re-queue at another weight.

items.title: MECH-482/SD-102 epistemic-deficit accumulator: multi-target readiness validation (supersedes V3-EXQ-964)
items.note: Validates substrate_queue entry sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness (implemented_pending_validation, severity degrading) -- the entry this run is the owed validation for. Owed residual of GFLAG-0215 (resolved; registry half landed in gov-flagbacklog-20260909). DESIGN: epistemic_deficit is ARMED ON BOTH ARMS (the V3-EXQ-964 defect was arming it on one arm only); the manipulation is the readiness GEOMETRY alone, all five levers incl. target_frame=predicted. 964's C2 was structurally unsatisfiable -- n_targets==1 made the readout candidate-constant, and a uniform constant cannot move an argmax, so its divergence of 0.0 was an arithmetic identity, not a measurement. C3 here is gated behind C1 (n_targets>=2), C2 (cross-candidate range > 0) and a MAGNITUDE gate measured post-F against E3.decisiveness_margin, so an unmet gate self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than any substrate verdict. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): checked v3_exq_964_mech482_epistemic_deficit_validation_20260829T215030Z_v3 -- it carries the decisive readouts (n_targets_min 1, yoked_divergence_frac_max 0.0) but only for the PRE-readiness substrate; the readiness knobs post-date that substrate_hash, so the readiness question is not recoverable from it -> run required. The broadcast-vs-epistemic_deficit contrast is NOT re-run; 964 already records it. RED-TEAM (Step 4.5) model: Opus 5 (session model; the fable override returned a spend-limit error, skill-sanctioned fallback). Verdict BLOCKING -> fixed before queueing: (1) epistemic_deficit_target_frame, the FIFTH readiness lever, was omitted -- under the 'realized' default no radius can both separate targets and match candidates (config.py:4733 measured note); (2) the reachability figure double-multiplied by curiosity_learning_progress_weight, since _last_lp_dev_range is computed from the already-weighted lp_contrib (structured_curiosity.py:548) -- was 20x understated; (3) accumulator counters are cleared by reset() every episode even under persist=True (epistemic_deficit.py:616-633), so run-lifetime totals are now accumulated per-episode; (4) vacuous rate was denominated on non-refused reads only, since mark_vacuous_readout never increments _n_readouts -- now denominated on all attempts; (5) C4 (instrument control) promoted to load-bearing, as a non-zero self-yoked divergence on EITHER arm voids the paired DV. DISPOSITIONED, not fixed: the reviewer wanted a binding gate on matched-target count; declined with citation -- under readout_mode=rbf_weighted the returned vector is a distance-weighted sum over ALL targets and the `matched` mask is never consulted (epistemic_deficit.py readout(), rbf branch), so gating on it would manufacture a substrate_not_ready verdict from a readout that is in fact differentiating. Matched counts are recorded as diagnostics instead. KNOWN LIMITATIONS, declared: repeated runs at a fixed seed are NOT bit-reproducible (the predecessor is), so every cell is stamped reuse-INELIGIBLE and must never be used as a baseline mint; within-run yoking IS exact (paired control 0.000000 on every observed run) and no load-bearing criterion depends on cross-run reproducibility. Yoking is non-compounding only while the arms agree -- the env is stepped with the reference arm's action. 1-seed full-scale probe: max_n_targets 13 (vs 1 pre-readiness), lp_dev_range 0.0129, distinct-matched 0, pert/margin 0.111, divergence 0.0 -> would route 'mixed' / readout_differentiates_but_never_changes_committed_action, which is a genuine measurement rather than 964's arithmetic zero. Step 2.5c: the one open corrupting entry overlapping this driver (mode-governance-engagement) matches only at module level on agent.py; its defect is the mode-hysteresis path and this experiment sets no mode-governance config -> not a stop.
